propositions: Batching multiple candidate digests into a single LLM call reduces total input tokens by 48% (17,558 → 9,116) compared to pre-batching baseline by eliminating redundant system prompt copies

System prompt now exceeds 1024-token cache floor (1,337 tokens) enabling prefix caching with 1,331 tokens written once then read on follow-up call, whereas hoisting alone at 873 tokens failed to cross the threshold

Verdict relation labels shift conservatively on 6/12 ordered pairs when batching multiple candidates together (mostly toward unrelated) but surfaced findings remain identical and self-duplicate positive control recovers at full confidence in both orderings

Batching reduces judge calls from 12 to 2 for 6 candidates per ordering via labelled candidate list in user message instead of one-per-pair calls, while shared query digest remains hoisted in system prompt
